messages.text: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list for Aerospace / Defense, but they support the following priority capabilities for satellite/A&D-style VNA/S-parameter work: wide frequency coverage, high dynamic range/sensitivity, group delay on frequency converters, time-domain / distance-to-fault, pulsed and mixer measurements, mmWave extension, deembedding / fixture removal, uncertainty analysis, and TVAC calibration / power-reference support [10][16][43][45][51][53][90][96].
| Capability | Why it matters for Aerospace / Defense applications | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Wide frequency coverage up to microwave/mmWave | R&S ZNA covers 10 MHz to 67 GHz, while R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz as a 1.0 mm VNA system [33][72]. | [33][72] |
| High dynamic range and sensitivity | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specified without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction; sensitivity is >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specified without options and –162 dBm measured with options normalized to 1 Hz [96]. | [96] |
| Group delay for satellite payload / frequency-converting paths | Group delay measurements characterize phase distortions in satellite communications transmission paths, and relative group delay of frequency converters or transponder channels is critical for determining distortion at channel band edges [55]. | [55] |
| Group delay on converters without LO access | R&S ZNA can measure group delay of frequency converters without LO access, especially when traditional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift/noise [51]. | [51] |
| Component-level satellite payload testing | The satellite payload source recommends R&S ZNA for component-level testing, while R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended for complete payload testing [53]. | [53] |
| Two-tone VNA group-delay method | R&S ZNA uses a two-tone stimulus, measures phase difference at DUT input/output, and calculates group delay from phase difference and frequency offset; calibration only requires an unknown through mixer [52]. | [52] |
| Time-domain / TDR and distance-to-fault | ZNB3000 software options include Time domain analysis, Distance to fault, and Extended time domain analysis [10]. | [10] |
| Frequency-conversion, mixer, and intermodulation measurements | ZNB3000 options include Frequency conversion and Intermodulation measurements, with intermodulation requiring the frequency-conversion option [10]. | [10] |
| Pulsed measurements | ZNB3000 includes a Pulsed source measurements option with internal pulsed source, and ZNA options include measurements on pulsed signals [10][16]. | [10][16] |
| mmWave converter support | ZNB3000 includes mmWave converter support, and ZNA67EXT requires mmWave converter support plus Continuous sweep 110 GHz for the 110 GHz system [10][16][30]. | [10][16][30] |
| Noise figure / gain-related characterization | ZNB3000 includes Noise figure measurement as a software option, and ZNL20 includes Noise figure and gain measurements requiring spectrum analysis option and an additional interface option [10][46]. | [10][46] |
| Deembedding / fixture compensation | ZNB3000 options include EaZy deembedding, In-situ deembedding, Smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [10]. | [10] |
| Real-time / measurement uncertainty analysis | ZNB3000 includes Real-time measurement uncertainty analysis, and ZNA includes Uncertainty analysis options [10][16]. | [10][16] |
| TVAC-compatible calibration / reference-plane maintenance | For satellite payload TVAC testing, Rohde & Schwarz developed calibration accessories to maintain accurate uplink/downlink reference-plane measurements, including inline calibration modules and power meters [45]. | [45] |
| TVAC power measurement near DUT | TVAC power sensors R&S NRP33SN-V and R&S NRP67SN-V are designed for TVAC, cover up to 33 GHz and 67 GHz respectively, support fast highly accurate power measurements, and placing sensors near the DUT can eliminate long RF cables and improve measurement accuracy [43]. | [43] |

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis 主要條件（摘錄）
- [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 的 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz，高於 R&S®ZNL20 的 VNA frequency range 5 kHz to 20 GHz；本頁依來源分別記錄，不合併。
- R&S®ZNL20-K14 independent CW source maximum output frequency = 20 GHz。
- Second harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 13 GHz，≤ –20 dBc，typical –35 dBc。
- Third harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 8.5 GHz，≤ –25 dBc，typical –40 dBc。
- Frequency response referenced to 50 MHz，RF attenuation 0 dB/10 dB/20 dB/30 dB，+18 °C to +28 °C：10 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz < 0.8 dB（σ = 0.1 dB）；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz < 1.3 dB（σ = 0.2 dB）；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz < 2.0 dB（σ = 0.5 dB）；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz < 2.5 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz < 3.0 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）。
- Total measurement uncertainty 條件：signal level 0 dB to –50 dB below reference level、S/N > 20 dB、sweep time auto、sweep type sweep、RF attenuation 10 dB/20 dB/30 dB、span/RBW < 100、95 % confidence level、+18 °C to +28 °C。R&S®ZNL20：3 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz 為 1 dB；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz 為 1.5 dB；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz 為 2.2 dB；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz 為 2.7 dB；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz 為 3.2 dB。

R&S ZNL20
[[R&S ZNL20]] 是 [[R&S ZNL]] 系列的 20 GHz 2-port Vector Network Analyzer，依 [[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]] Version 10.00（September 2025）標示，VNA frequency range 為 5 kHz to 20 GHz，test port connector 為 3.5 mm, male；加裝 [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 時 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis option
| Code | Order No. | 名稱 / 原文說明 | 相依 / 限制 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| R&S®ZNL20-B1 | 1303.8101.02 | Spectrum analysis，for R&S®ZNL20 | devices with serial number < 101200 cannot retrofit |

With R&S®ZNL20-B1 spectrum analysis option：

- Spectrum analysis frequency range：5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。
- RF input impedance：50 Ω。
- RF input connector：see section Measurement range, Test port connector，即 3.5 mm, male。
- Attenuator setting range：0 dB to 30 dB，10 dB steps。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Number of sweep / trace points：default 1001；range 101 to 100001。
- Signal analysis bandwidth equalized：standard 10 MHz nominal；f < 6 GHz with [[R&S FPL1-B40]] option 為 40 MHz nominal；f ≥ 6 GHz with [[R&S FPL1-B40]] and [[R&S FPL1-B11]] options，YIG preselector off，為 40 MHz nominal。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 的 two independent LOs for internal receivers 可讓 mixers 的 RF/IF 同時量測。
- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

依來源：

- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]] power sensors 專為 TVAC 設計，符合 European Space Agency norms。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 使用限制
- 本頁的 accuracy 數字與 method benefits 來自 2022 application brochure；實際性能需依 DUT、frequency range、bandwidth、SNR、option 與 calibration setup 確認。
- 本頁不取代 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 的正式規格書。
- 來源未提供完整 uncertainty budget、test limits、標準章節或 test case ID。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 為什麼量測 group delay
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

answer.text:
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list for Aerospace / Defense, but they support the following priority capabilities for satellite/A&D-style VNA/S-parameter work: wide frequency coverage, high dynamic range/sensitivity, group delay on frequency converters, time-domain / distance-to-fault, pulsed and mixer measurements, mmWave extension, deembedding / fixture removal, uncertainty analysis, and TVAC calibration / power-reference support [10][16][43][45][51][53][90][96].
| Capability | Why it matters for Aerospace / Defense applications | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Wide frequency coverage up to microwave/mmWave | R&S ZNA covers 10 MHz to 67 GHz, while R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz as a 1.0 mm VNA system [33][72]. | [33][72] |
| High dynamic range and sensitivity | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specified without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction; sensitivity is >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specified without options and –162 dBm measured with options normalized to 1 Hz [96]. | [96] |
| Group delay for satellite payload / frequency-converting paths | Group delay measurements characterize phase distortions in satellite communications transmission paths, and relative group delay of frequency converters or transponder channels is critical for determining distortion at channel band edges [55]. | [55] |
| Group delay on converters without LO access | R&S ZNA can measure group delay of frequency converters without LO access, especially when traditional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift/noise [51]. | [51] |
| Component-level satellite payload testing | The satellite payload source recommends R&S ZNA for component-level testing, while R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended for complete payload testing [53]. | [53] |
| Two-tone VNA group-delay method | R&S ZNA uses a two-tone stimulus, measures phase difference at DUT input/output, and calculates group delay from phase difference and frequency offset; calibration only requires an unknown through mixer [52]. | [52] |
| Time-domain / TDR and distance-to-fault | ZNB3000 software options include Time domain analysis, Distance to fault, and Extended time domain analysis [10]. | [10] |
| Frequency-conversion, mixer, and intermodulation measurements | ZNB3000 options include Frequency conversion and Intermodulation measurements, with intermodulation requiring the frequency-conversion option [10]. | [10] |
| Pulsed measurements | ZNB3000 includes a Pulsed source measurements option with internal pulsed source, and ZNA options include measurements on pulsed signals [10][16]. | [10][16] |
| mmWave converter support | ZNB3000 includes mmWave converter support, and ZNA67EXT requires mmWave converter support plus Continuous sweep 110 GHz for the 110 GHz system [10][16][30]. | [10][16][30] |
| Noise figure / gain-related characterization | ZNB3000 includes Noise figure measurement as a software option, and ZNL20 includes Noise figure and gain measurements requiring spectrum analysis option and an additional interface option [10][46]. | [10][46] |
| Deembedding / fixture compensation | ZNB3000 options include EaZy deembedding, In-situ deembedding, Smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [10]. | [10] |
| Real-time / measurement uncertainty analysis | ZNB3000 includes Real-time measurement uncertainty analysis, and ZNA includes Uncertainty analysis options [10][16]. | [10][16] |
| TVAC-compatible calibration / reference-plane maintenance | For satellite payload TVAC testing, Rohde & Schwarz developed calibration accessories to maintain accurate uplink/downlink reference-plane measurements, including inline calibration modules and power meters [45]. | [45] |
| TVAC power measurement near DUT | TVAC power sensors R&S NRP33SN-V and R&S NRP67SN-V are designed for TVAC, cover up to 33 GHz and 67 GHz respectively, support fast highly accurate power measurements, and placing sensors near the DUT can eliminate long RF cables and improve measurement accuracy [43]. | [43] |

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › TVAC power sensors
依來源：

- 將 sensors 靠近 DUT 量測，可消除 long RF cables 的需求並改善 measurement accuracy。
- Rohde & Schwarz TVAC cables 與 special LAN feedthroughs 使用 vacuum friendly materials，並已 baked 以消除 VOC 與其他 contaminants。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 為什麼量測 group delay
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- [[Group delay]] measurements 用於表徵 satellite communications transmission path 的 phase distortions。
- Bandpass filter 會在 band edges 增加更多 group delay。
- 在 satellite communications systems 中，frequency converter 或 transponder channels 的 relative group delay 對判定 each channel band edges 的 distortion amount 很關鍵。
